baseline.proof: For each positive9 principal Gram M, M^-1 is entrywise nonnegative. Projecting a common strict timelike center onto these nine walls gives a future timelike point, exactly nine zero inequalities, and every other inequality strict. Every actual endpoint of a rank8 spherical edge requires a positive or positive-semidefinite ninth-wall Gram. All remaining walls are tested; a dotted pair already excludes positive semidefiniteness. Thus each saved finite-open edge reaches the ideal boundary with no other wall active. This classifies the connected finite-vertex components reached here, not disconnected components.
